predecessors.name: Socialist Republic of Romania
predecessors.text: the same land, unchanged ('Name changed to "Romania": 28 December 1989')

ledger.x: 1989-12: Romania, no longer socialist, takes its name after the fall of Ceausescu.

certainty.note: The frontiers are those of the Socialist Republic and earlier treaties; the pages read give no treaty or change after 1989 (the Romania page is silent on Ukraine, Moldova and the Black Sea delimitation).
